ledger: Space A (exterior): desert roadside, gravel shoulder with a two-lane road with yellow center dashes behind/left of the car; scrub, distant purple mountains, telephone poles visible from ~4.5s as the camera arcs around. The background stays consistent throughout.
Space B (interior): cabin of a cream station wagon with wood-panel sides, roof rack and plate 'STE 97'. Visible side = driver side (car nose faces camera-left).

Openings of B: windshield (shows dashboard, front seats, steering wheel and rear-view mirror); driver front door window directly behind the driver side mirror; rear side windows. Through the glass you see the seats and the desert, which fits.
Car geometry: hood -> cowl/wipers -> windshield -> A-pillar -> driver side mirror -> front door window. The engine bay and fender are ahead of the A-pillar, and there is no opening there.

Woman (denim jacket, arms crossed): 0:00-1:75 her torso rises from the hood/cowl at the right edge of the windshield, LEFT of (forward of) the side mirror and A-pillar, with her forearms on the hood. The near-side fender below her is unobstructed (no legs or body outside the car), so she is not standing beside the car.

Woman 3:00-6:00: as the camera moves forward and left, she stays in front of the windshield glass, between the wiper arms and the A-pillar, with her elbows on the hood. The cabin seats and steering wheel show behind her through the glass.

Woman 6:00-9:75: close-up with the windshield/door frame and seats behind her shoulder. It reads as if she is leaning out of the driver window, but her arms still rest on the hood ahead of the A-pillar.
Traversals: none. Nobody moves between spaces; the camera does a continuous push-in/arc.

Functional arrangement: the antenna, mirror, wipers and roof rack are placed plausibly. The antenna base appears to move from the fender to the hood/cowl as the camera moves; parallax probably explains this, so it is not flagged.

findings.entity: woman's body vs. the station wagon's openings (cowl/hood area forward of the A-pillar)
findings.invariant_violated: occupant must pass through an existing opening
findings.description: She is posed as if leaning out of the car window, but her torso comes up through solid bodywork. She sits forward of the A-pillar and driver side mirror, overlapping the windshield's outer edge, with her forearms on the hood. No window or door opening exists there; it is the cowl/engine-bay area. The fender below her is empty, which rules out standing outside the car. This continues all the way through (frames 00:00-09:75, e.g. 00:00 and 06:50 full-res), with the wipers on one side of her and the A-pillar/door window on the other. The actual driver window is behind the mirror and is not the opening she occupies.
